title: Nifty Bank hits ALL-TIME HIGH 62,324 | What just happened? #Shorts
description:
Nifty Bank hit 62,324 today — an all-time high. First time ever above 62,000.

FIIs poured ₹56,771 Cr into Indian markets in just 8 sessions. PNB at an 8-year high ₹151.60. PSU Bank Index +2.3%. Credit growth 19.4% YoY.

Watch Dec 6 — the RBI policy decision will set the next direction for banking stocks.

Educational content only.
